title: Production of Mobile Game Character Skins
content:
This is the Vegetable Elf - themed skin for the hero Zhong Wuyan in the mobile game Honor of Kings. I replicated it in CLO3D, and the renderings are shown below.

![b62605513ca843fe903d1b30781c5797](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/b62605513ca843fe903d1b30781c5797%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_11.png)

![097ff00d3b8842f589b6b29e3e3f5230](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/097ff00d3b8842f589b6b29e3e3f5230%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_10.png)

![91550b827fd24036b894595f0acc35ec](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/91550b827fd24036b894595f0acc35ec%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_9.png)

![9e98ddef73ce42109208f2f24d336196](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/9e98ddef73ce42109208f2f24d336196%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_8.png)

![2bc7035a3e724926b7ab6a2b7f199163](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/2bc7035a3e724926b7ab6a2b7f199163%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_7.png)

![c6ff299ab4d14d60ab181f92e11e4b58](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/c6ff299ab4d14d60ab181f92e11e4b58%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_6.png)

![464687615639462d9dffcf2ab53b1292](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/464687615639462d9dffcf2ab53b1292%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_5.png)It looks pretty good. It's just a bit time - consuming, but I still think it's a good challenge.

* * *

Now, let's take a look at my production process together.

![1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-09%20145559.png)First, I made her weapon, then created the movements and matched the weapon's state with the postures. After that, I could focus on making the clothing at ease.

![2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20133420.png)![82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20124135.png)Based on my background in fashion, I first fully replicated the character's clothing. Using the default model's measurements, the clothing's structure, details, and fabric are all intact.

* * *

![aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-14%20100800.png)The trousers are relatively simple. The structure of the vest is actually quite interesting, and I made it according to my own understanding.

![950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20223034.png)Finally, I combined them together and then went on to complete the other details.

![7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_F.png)![8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152744.png)This is the complete A - pose effect.

* * *

Then I simulated the clothing on the model's pose that was determined at the beginning.

![c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152302.png)![cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20124454.png)And that's it. The result is quite good. However, it really did require a great deal of patience to carry this out. Fortunately, the outcome is satisfying. At the same time, I've also identified many areas for improvement, and I hope to overcome them one by one in the future.

* * *

Please click the link to view the action postures:<https://connect.clo-set.com/zh/detail/bc62cad41f4142508796397452bb37a1?ref_id=108936>

Please click this link to view the A - pose:<https://connect.clo-set.com/zh/detail/1ce7f5c8c84f410fa08d909a1c2b5b2e?ref_id=108936>

Please click this link to view the weapon details:<https://connect.clo-set.com/zh/detail/91152373612b477b82f982c62244f2b2?ref_id=108936>

* * *

Thank you for checking it out. Head over to my homepage and hit that follow button so you won't miss out!
